cost: Plain layout O(bytes); cut worst bounded closers scan can be quadratic in long closer sequences. residual O(pieces+tokens+marks+stored bytes) excluding copier. Copier retains all history O(H bytes); <=51 candidates but each comparison O(length), map O(log histories). repeat caller may clone entire history.
description: txt_volume preserves paragraphs and layout, with_marks inserts markup at byte coordinates. segment aligns tokens against text then cut partitions punctuation boundaries; residual records noncanonical gaps/tails and charges layout/markup. decode_blocks combines canonical spaces and residual overrides, volume_text reapplies pieces/marks. Copier scans next/recent/head/tail candidates, picks strictly cheaper copy, verifies decode, updates counters/history.
forward: txt_volume preserves paragraphs and layout, with_marks inserts markup at byte coordinates. segment aligns tokens against text then cut partitions punctuation boundaries; residual records noncanonical gaps/tails and charges layout/markup. decode_blocks combines canonical spaces and residual overrides, volume_text reapplies pieces/marks. Copier scans next/recent/head/tail candidates, picks strictly cheaper copy, verifies decode, updates counters/history.
inverse: Residual coordinate override wins over canonical gaps; metadata always charged; Given/Conllu/FrTable literals excluded here. Copier never selects equal-cost copy over current candidate; returned code costs <=whole flag+literal bits on admitted domain.

Token forms, spacing bits, gap/tail residual, pieces and ordered marks reconstruct bytes. Forms alone have many whitespace/layout antecedents. Copy plus referenced history reconstructs literal, but code alone does not recover absent history. Counter totals lose sequence.
limitations: Partial source syntax and finite pure-code tests only; no model loading, live corpus/site/lesson workflows, full pipeline or persistent learning claim.
No executable percentage surrogate or semantic proof; explicit codec domains and resource limits apply.
